mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate relative to its historical average compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% for two consecutive months signals an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (both below their 3-month moving averages) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below the 12-month moving average by more than 1.0% signals weak consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS falls below the 12-month MA by more than 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) below its 6-month moving average indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is below its 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to higher discount rates, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months signals a recession in the industrial sector, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 100 for two consecutive months.
